name: ledger-lens
description: Ledger Lens - an Open Banking proof of concept (account information + payment initiation) with an API Inspector.

scripts.dev: npm run check:node && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names api,web --prefix-colors blue,magenta "npm:dev:api" "npm:dev:web"
scripts.build: npm run check:node && npm run build -w @ledger-lens/api && npm run build -w @ledger-lens/web
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p e2e/tsconfig.json && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.verify: npm run check:node && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
